SELECT 
  CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(h.clock), '+00:00', '+03:00') AS Timestamp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.value = 'Connected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Cameras Online"
FROM history_str h
JOIN (
    SELECT itemid, MAX(clock) AS max_clock
    FROM history_str
    GROUP BY itemid
) ult ON h.itemid = ult.itemid AND h.clock = ult.max_clock
JOIN items i ON h.itemid = i.itemid
JOIN hosts ht ON i.hostid = ht.hostid
JOIN hosts_groups hg ON hg.hostid = ht.hostid
JOIN hstgrp gp ON gp.groupid = hg.groupid
WHERE gp.name = 'NVR' 
  AND ht.name = 'NVR 01'
  AND i.key_ LIKE 'remoteCam[status%'
;

SELECT 
  CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(h.clock), '+00:00', '+03:00') AS Timestamp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.value = 'Unconnect' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Cameras Offline"
FROM history_str h
JOIN (
    SELECT itemid, MAX(clock) AS max_clock
    FROM history_str
    GROUP BY itemid
) ult ON h.itemid = ult.itemid AND h.clock = ult.max_clock
JOIN items i ON h.itemid = i.itemid
JOIN hosts ht ON i.hostid = ht.hostid
JOIN hosts_groups hg ON hg.hostid = ht.hostid
JOIN hstgrp gp ON gp.groupid = hg.groupid
WHERE gp.name = 'NVR' 
  AND ht.name = 'NVR 01'
  AND i.key_ LIKE 'remoteCam[status%'
;

SELECT
  cam_names.value AS "Câmera",
  cam_status.value AS "Status"
FROM hosts ht
JOIN hosts_groups hg ON hg.hostid = ht.hostid
JOIN hstgrp gp ON gp.groupid = hg.groupid

-- Nomes das câmeras (último valor válido)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    i.hostid,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.key_, '[0-9]+(?=\]$)') AS cam_index,
    h.value
  FROM items i
  JOIN history_str h 
    ON h.itemid = i.itemid
  JOIN (
    SELECT itemid, MAX(clock) AS max_clock
    FROM history_str
    GROUP BY itemid
  ) ult ON ult.itemid = h.itemid AND ult.max_clock = h.clock
  WHERE i.key_ LIKE 'remoteCam[name%'
) AS cam_names ON cam_names.hostid = ht.hostid

-- Status das câmeras (último valor válido)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    i.hostid,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.key_, '[0-9]+(?=\]$)') AS cam_index,
    h.value
  FROM items i
  JOIN history_str h 
    ON h.itemid = i.itemid
  JOIN (
    SELECT itemid, MAX(clock) AS max_clock
    FROM history_str
    GROUP BY itemid
  ) ult ON ult.itemid = h.itemid AND ult.max_clock = h.clock
  WHERE i.key_ LIKE 'remoteCam[status%'
) AS cam_status ON cam_status.hostid = ht.hostid 
               AND cam_status.cam_index = cam_names.cam_index

WHERE ht.name = 'NVR 01'
ORDER BY cam_status.value DESC;

WITH cte_cams AS (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(cam_status.clock), '+00:00', '+03:00') AS "TimestampStatus",	
    cam_names.value AS "Câmera",
    (CASE WHEN cam_status.value = 'Connected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Status"
  FROM hosts ht
  JOIN hosts_groups hg ON hg.hostid = ht.hostid
  JOIN hstgrp gp ON gp.groupid = hg.groupid
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      i.hostid,
      REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.key_, '[0-9]+(?=\]$)') AS cam_index,
      h.clock AS clock,
      h.value
    FROM items i
    JOIN history_str h ON h.itemid = i.itemid
    WHERE i.key_ LIKE 'remoteCam[name%' AND h.clock > UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
  ) AS cam_names ON cam_names.hostid = ht.hostid
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      i.hostid,
      REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.key_, '[0-9]+(?=\]$)') AS cam_index,
      h.clock AS clock,
      h.value
    FROM items i
    JOIN history_str h ON h.itemid = i.itemid
    WHERE i.key_ LIKE 'remoteCam[status%' AND h.clock > UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
  ) AS cam_status ON cam_status.hostid = ht.hostid AND cam_status.cam_index = cam_names.cam_index
  WHERE ht.name = 'NVR 01'
  GROUP BY TimestampStatus, cam_names.value
),
cte_filtrada AS (
  SELECT 
    TimestampStatus,
    Câmera,
    Status,
    MIN(Status) OVER(PARTITION BY Câmera) AS menor_status_periodo
  FROM cte_cams
)
SELECT 
  TimestampStatus,
  Câmera,
  Status
FROM cte_filtrada
WHERE menor_status_periodo = 0
ORDER BY Câmera ASC, TimestampStatus ASC;
